No, we cannot. According to **Purchase Policy §6.2** (and **Supplier Policy §4.1**), parts that come into contact with food—such as gaskets—may be bought **only** from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if a supplier's price is better, a valid certificate is strictly required before any order can be placed.

Shakti Seals is not yet registered in Bahi, and because the 5-litre silicone gasket is a food-contact part, Purchase Policy §6.2 and Supplier Policy §4.1 require the supplier to hold a valid food-grade certificate on file before any order can be placed.
